name: mt_bench_deepl_translated_fi_no_code_math
description: A Finnish translation of the MT-Bench prompt suite with code- and math-related items removed. It is intended to evaluate instruction-following and general conversational/generation abilities of LLMs in Finnish across open-ended prompts using pairwise/composite scoring. Useful for benchmarking Finnish-capable models while avoiding code/math task bias.
evaluation_method: human_eval / model_scoring (pairwise preference and composite scoring)
reputation: A localized variant of the widely cited MT-Bench; used within the Finnish NLP community but has limited adoption outside that niche.
